default/31338.htm.text: Spellbook Seller Anton: Welcome! This is Elmore's famous landmark, the Library of Sages. It contains more books than anywhere else in the entire kingdom.

Q00110_ToThePrimevalIsle/31338-0a.htm.text: Spellbook Seller Anton: While clearing out the library's underground warehouse one day, I discovered a very old, very worn-out book filled with snatches of some unkown ancient language. I have tried to translate it without success, but I recently learned that this book is very valuable. I am lookin…

Q00110_ToThePrimevalIsle/31338-0b.htm.text: Spellbook Seller Anton: Have you heard of the book entitled "Traces of Living Beings in Ancient Times?" Q00110_ToThePrimevalIsle/31338-1a.html.text: Spellbook Seller Anton: Please take that book to Marquez at the wharf on Primeval Isle. I know that you'll enjoy meeting him. An old adventurer himself, he always has time to talk to a young up-and-comer such as yourself.

Q00110_ToThePrimevalIsle/31338-0c.htm.text: Spellbook Seller Anton: A few days ago, Clark -- the most avid reader in all Rune Town -- stopped by and asked to see all the books I had cleared out from the underground warehouse. Clark told Marquez about my discovery, and Marquez wrote to me asking that he be allowed to obtain the book to assist the writing of his own history of the island.
